sloka: आरभस्व शुभश्रोणि वनवासक्षमाः क्रियाः ।नेदानीम् त्वदृते सीते स्वर्गोऽपि मम रोचते ॥२-३०-४२॥
transliteration: ārabhasva śubhaśroṇi vanavāsakṣamāḥ kriyāḥ ।nedānīm tvadṛte sīte svargo'pi mama rocate ॥2-30-42॥

translations.english: O Sita, begin right now all preparations necessary for residing in the forest. O one, with beautiful buttocks, without you even the very heaven does not please me.
